pages.heading: Welcome to Em3k
pages.subhead: Learn anywhere, even when you are offline.

blocks.content: Em3k is a course viewer designed around portable course packages. Once a course is available on your device, you can read it without staying connected to the internet.

blocks.title: Start here
blocks.content: This tutorial is available from Help. The Discovering Peru course is already in your Library so you can try a regular course right away.

items: Use the course controls to move through pages and lessons.
Open the Library to manage courses installed in this viewer.
Use Help to return to this tutorial.
